core_meaning.primary_meaning: Nazeer is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Warner, one who warns”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Nazeer corresponds to the Arabic form نَذِير (Arabic root ن ذ ر (n-dh-r); نَذِير (Nadhīr)). Its core sense is warner, one who warns. Nazeer is Arabic نَذِير (Nadhīr) 'warner, one who warns', from the root ن ذ ر (n-dh-r). CRITICAL SOURCE ERROR: the source gave ناظر (a different form); the correct form is نَذِير. The source gloss 'Observer, Seer' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense. Same name as nadheer.
